status: raw source qualification; auto_control_eligible always false
identity: yandex:native: plus exact UTF-8 SegmentEvent field2; no ID transformation

classification.warning: other recognized EventTag tokens, including police alone
classification.unknown: retain alongside known tokens; unknown-only event omitted

position: field1 zero-based edge index; field7 fraction [0,1]; field5 optional PointGeo field1 longitude/field2 latitude doubles
geometry: road_geometry two directed (longitude,latitude) degree points; road_heading_deg is route edge bearing, not camera facing
physical_position: reported PointGeo when present, otherwise edge interpolation; >30m mismatch rejected

speed.road_limit_raw_mps: Route.getSpeedLimits-equivalent RLE value at exact event edge index
speed.road_limit_kph: positive raw*3.6 rounded only within 0.0001 of an integer; null/zero or noncanonical value remains unknown
speed.qualification: SDK 4.45.0-full: parent evidence of 134 exact directed SDK edge matches, zero raw difference, official canonical 20/40/60
speed.direction: acquired_route_forward_edge only; no opposite-direction limit inferred

freshness: observed_at fixed at completed acquisition; local policy expiry mobile180s, fixed/warning300s; expired reads return no record
directions: in_face/in_back retained separately; direction null; mobile never filtered by facing
no_control: normalizer supplies no control eligibility, vehicle matching, passage, planner or restoration changes
